prompt: Build the main dashboard for an invoicing app: monthly revenue, outstanding balance, on-time payment rate and customer count, a weekly collections chart, recent activity, and a table of recent invoices.
Build the workspace settings page: profile (name, email), invoicing defaults (payment terms, currency), notification preferences, and a danger zone to delete the workspace.
Build the sign-in screen with email and password, a forgot-password link, and a link to create an account.
Build the invoices list page with a search field, status filter, a table of invoices (number, customer, issue date, due date, status, amount) and a button to create a new invoice.
Build the customers page for a brand-new account that has no customers yet, encouraging the user to add their first customer.

Build an invoice detail page: invoice header with status, bill-to and bill-from blocks, line items with quantities and totals, payment history, and actions to send a reminder, download PDF, or void the invoice.
Build a form to add a new customer: company name, contact name, email, phone, billing address, tax ID and default payment terms.
Build a pricing page with three plans (Solo, Team, Business), a monthly/yearly toggle, a feature comparison and an FAQ.
Build the team members page: list of members with role and last active date, pending invitations, and a way to invite someone by email.
Build a reports page showing revenue by month for the year, top customers by revenue, average days to pay, and an export button.
